dyo_keeper.text: Mind where you tread. Three thousand years of other people's belongings is down here, and the cave doesn't do lost property.
In 1912 two brothers paddled a coracle up the river with candles. They didn't know what they'd found. That is the best way to find anything.

then.text: You've been in the hollow, I see. Cave pearls grow round because the drip keeps turning them. Rather like some of my colleagues.

else.text: There's a hollow in the flowstone at the back with a few cave pearls in it. Take one for your trouble. One. They take longer to grow than a degree.
